scenarios.origin: commit 4747029e — real bug: a generation change during a quiescing transition dropped the pending terminal
scenarios.hypothesis: a cancel-pending critical section is terminalized with its requested outcome when the generation changes; it must not be suspended with pending control state

scenarios.origin: stale/reordered completion class — effect completion arriving before dispatch linearization
scenarios.hypothesis: a reconcile that precedes BEGIN_EFFECT_DISPATCH is rejected; a commit can never dispatch twice

scenarios.origin: duplicate irreversible effect class — a dispatched commit must be single-use even when the world effect failed
scenarios.hypothesis: dispatch linearization is the irreversible act; a NOT_OCCURRED reconcile still consumes the permit and a replacement issue is refused

scenarios.origin: orphan transition class — a superseded mission predicate must not leave a resumable authority shell
scenarios.hypothesis: a superseded-then-restored predicate cannot resurrect the terminalized transition; frontier re-derivation requires a fresh transition

scenarios.origin: finding F-K3 — cooperative safe-yield bound is observational, not enforced
scenarios.hypothesis: CHARACTERIZATION: a preemptible victim that never yields wedges a higher-priority preemptor past the yield deadline; the only kernel recourse is victim terminalization

scenarios.origin: finding F-K4 — PAUSE_ACTIVE/ACK_PAUSE_YIELD do not gate on preemptionYielded
scenarios.hypothesis: CHARACTERIZATION: an acknowledged victim can be paused out of a READY transaction, releasing leases outside the atomic commit and leaving an unresolvable STALE plan

scenarios.origin: finding F-K8 — world change vs generation change asymmetry for pending verified outcomes
scenarios.hypothesis: CHARACTERIZATION: a world change discards a pending verified SUCCESS and records WORLD_CHANGED, while a generation change would honor it — old-world verify cannot certify the new world

scenarios.origin: generation rebind during an acknowledged preemption — mechanical authority must not survive the rebind
scenarios.hypothesis: a generation change mid-READY-preemption stales the plan, suspends both parties, and requires fresh lease identities to reactivate

scenarios.origin: stale completion class — yield acknowledgements must be bound to the current monotonic instant
scenarios.hypothesis: every quiescing edge rejects an acknowledgement recorded for an older instant

scenarios.origin: crash/replay class — the journaled protocol must reproduce exactly after a mid-protocol crash
scenarios.hypothesis: a journal cut after a dispatch and a preemption plan replays to the identical semantic state and continues the protocol under trusted recovery

scenarios.origin: docs/history/incidents/NETHER-SURVIVAL-2026-09-22.md — threat contact with wrong gear and ungrounded response (94% of Nether expeditions lost the body)
scenarios.hypothesis: a contact threat must produce a grounded survival response, not ungrounded candidate churn

scenarios.origin: docs/history/incidents/BUDDY-DEFECTS.md defect A — no-progress motion loop dominated the queue while nothing verified
scenarios.hypothesis: stuck/stale movement must terminalize as a typed failure instead of wedging the queue

scenarios.origin: docs/history/incidents/BUDDY-DEFECTS.md defects B/C — dig interrupted before block broke; wrong tool for the resource class
scenarios.hypothesis: dig completion and tool choice are bound to ground truth, not candidate claims

scenarios.origin: live regression — remembered drop/resource cells went stale and drove approaches to dead locations
scenarios.hypothesis: stale remembered cells are fenced before they can ground an approach

scenarios.origin: migration invariant — legacy Executor claim must never overlap VTR body authority
scenarios.hypothesis: the legacy claim path refuses while a VTR transition owns the body

scenarios.origin: P1 boundary pin — legacy Reach locomotion to a mission source is withheld while VTR owns the mission
scenarios.hypothesis: the strangler withholds same-predicate locomotion and nothing else
